identitySignals: Agenda names 'Scribble Software' in Pineville, NC; a public article describes Scribbles Software as located in Pineville, NC (Learning Counsel/EdCircuit, PR Newswire)
Agenda item is a Technology Services Department services agreement plus a Student Data Privacy Agreement; Scribbles Software sells K-12 student records and enrollment software, which matches
Search results show Oakland Unified's own records-request portals (ousdca.scriborder.com, ousdcaae.scriborder.com) are run on Scribbles Software's platform (page itself could not be fetched)
research.notes: Not to be confused with scribblesoftware.com (a marina software company in Virginia). Scribbles' old website scribsoft.com now redirects to parchment.com after the 2024 acquisition, so website is left null. No contact details or registry IDs (NC Secretary of State / SAM) were verified, so they are null. The 2021-22 agreement predates the acquisition.

profile.summary: Scribbles Software provides software for K-12 school districts, including online student records management, enrollment, school choice and lottery programs, and transcript ordering. It was acquired by Instructure (Parchment) in July 2024.

sources.title: ScribFolders from Scribbles Software Helps Schools Go Paperless
Instructure Completes the Acquisition of Scribbles

review.notes: Scribbles Software (K-12 student records, enrollment, lottery, transcript ordering; Pineville/Charlotte NC) matches the agenda's Pineville, NC location and the Student Data Privacy Agreement; the July 1, 2024 Instructure acquisition is confirmed by the press release. Headquarters Pineville, NC is stated by the EdCircuit article, though the Instructure release says Charlotte (adjacent area).
